name: SVR Poker Android

tablePolicy.humanRejoinBehavior: A deliberate leave clears the interrupted hand. JOIN TABLE starts a fresh six-player test table with 15,000 chips per seat.

androidExperience.audioMode: Web Audio synthesized poker effects with no missing-file dependency

avatarProfileProtection.note: Avatar and profile systems remain connected. Persistent production bankroll and AWS database writes are not claimed in Phase 363.

required: Lobby starts with no visible cards
Exactly one JOIN TABLE / LEAVE TABLE control
RAISE opens one drawer and confirmed amount increases the bet
Preflop exposes zero community cards and zero burns
Flop exposes three community cards after burn one
Turn exposes one additional card after burn two
River exposes one additional card after burn three
Human receives a betting action on preflop, flop, turn, and river
CHECK and CALL buttons execute through the Android HUD
Complete hand settles while conserving 90,000 chips
LEAVE returns to lobby, clears cards, and stops future deals
Verified GLB or FBX table is authority
No browser errors or failed asset requests

realDeviceValidation.target: Verify JOIN, RAISE slider/confirm, CHECK, CALL, LEAVE, gyro smoothing, touch drag, portrait/landscape FOV, vibration, seated left-right head movement, and no cards while in the lobby on the owner Android device.

updateMessage: An optional SVR Poker Android update is available.
updateMenuPolicy: Hidden unless releaseReady is true, apkUrl is non-empty, and apkVersionCode is newer than the installed code.
notes: Phase 363 changes the remotely loaded Android web runtime and does not require reinstalling APK 0.1.0-rc1.
Phase 336 remains the poker rules, burn-card, dealing, hand evaluation, pot, and payout authority.
Phase 347 remains the only Android MOVE, LOOK, and poker-button controller.
Phase 357 remains the protected Android table/status/seating presentation authority.

Phase 363 adds the final Android lobby/seated state, 15,000-chip test bankroll, one JOIN/LEAVE control, reliable RAISE capture, street-order auditing, audio, haptics, gyro/touch view, responsive FOV, and verified table asset authority.
No OBJ table is checked into the repository; the verified GLB is preferred and the verified FBX remains fallback.
Direct AWS/RDS bankroll synchronization, JWT login, table carousel, networked emotes, and positional dealer voice remain future server-backed phases and are not represented as complete.
APK version name 0.1.0-rc1, version code 1, manual-update-only, forceUpdate false, and showUpdatePrompt false remain locked.
